findings.finding: Core's CONN-TH_XDJK-0271-1650 footprint has only the 3 pin holes and no holes for the jack's 2 locating posts. Lite's copy has NPTH 1.7x2.4 ovals at (+-7.65,+1.60). The courtyards differ too (core x+-8,y-3.45..21.8; Lite x-8.75..12.3,y-4.3..15.2).
findings.evidence: Board dump of J4/J5 vs lite J2/J3. Lian Xin drawing A-AV2-7A1 (LCSC C7527522): 3-dia1.6 pin holes plus 2-2X3 post holes; pins 4.5 mm below the base, snap-in side legs 3.5 mm. With the legs standing on the board the pins enter only 1.0 mm of the 1.6 mm board.
findings.fix: Use Lite's footprint on core and enlarge the post holes to 2.0x3.0 NPTH slots per the drawing. Re-run courtyard/DRC.
findings.margin: Pin protrusion -0.6 mm (1.0 mm into a 1.6 mm board)

findings.finding: RCA post holes are 1.7x2.4, smaller than the drawing's 2.0x3.0. The footprint's signal pins sit on rows 0.8 mm apart (y -1.95/-1.15); the drawing shows both on one row 8 mm apart.
findings.evidence: Drawing A-AV2-7A1. Pin 1.0x0.3 brass (diagonal 1.04) in 1.6 hole = 0.28 mm radial slack against a possible 0.8 mm position error.
findings.fix: Check a real part against a 1:1 print, or buy 2 pcs of C7527522 first. Make the post holes 2.0x3.0. If the pins mismatch, make pins 1/3 plated 1.6x2.4 ovals along y.
findings.margin: Unverified: slack 0.28 mm vs a possible 0.8 mm error

findings.finding: No heatsink mounting holes for the TPA3221. The DDV package's thermal slug is on TOP and needs a grounded heatsink; core has only the 4 corner M3 holes.
findings.evidence: TI SLASEE9C sec 5 + pin table (PowerPAD on top, connect to grounded heatsink); RthJA 44.8 C/W no heatsink vs 5.5 C/W with heatsink -> Tj 150 C at 2.5 W from 40 C ambient (~22 W total out at 90% eff).
findings.fix: Add 2x M3 3.2 mm PTH GND holes per amp either side of U15/U16 (~25-30 mm apart), keep a ~30x20 mm area clear of parts taller than 1.5 mm, put the heatsink in the BOM as hand-fit.
findings.margin: 2.5 W dissipation limit without a heatsink

findings.finding: U18 IRM-H638T is a top-looking SMD IR receiver (lens on top) 3 mm from the bottom edge. Under a Plus lid it needs a window or light pipe at least ~21.6 mm tall; Lite uses a front-facing THT IRM-3638T.
findings.evidence: Everlight DMO-0000008 rev3 p6 top view shows the lens; tallest core part is C5/C6 at 20 mm (C88733). Land pattern: Everlight wants pads at +-3.15, the footprint has +-2.95 (toe 0.2 mm vs 0.4).
findings.fix: Use the IRM-3638T THT front-facing receiver (C42421366) at the front edge like Lite, or put a window in the lid within +-45 deg above U18.

findings.finding: 3D models: core names models for 278/282 footprints and 241 exist (36 C0603 + SC-70 missing). Lite's 26 aiee model paths point at a lib/aiee.3dshapes that doesn't exist. The 470 uF model is H16 against a real 20 mm part.
findings.evidence: Board footprint model fields checked against the files; LCSC C88733 D10xL20.
findings.fix: Copy aiee.3dshapes to Lite and fix the 470 uF model height to 20 mm before any enclosure-height check.
findings.margin: 4 mm understatement on the tallest part

findings.finding: New USB4085-GF-A (THT, C7095263): GCT's and EasyEDA's pattern is a 0.40 drill in a 0.65 pad, annulus 0.125 mm, below JLC's multilayer PTH absolute minimum of 0.15. At 0.85 pitch, a 0.70 pad (KiCad lib) gives a 0.15 annulus and a 0.15 pad gap. THT at JLC is hand/selective solder; 16 joints at 0.85 pitch risk VBUS-CC bridges under the shell.
findings.evidence: GCT USB4085 rev B sheet 2; EasyEDA C7095263 pad hole r=0.787 units (0.40 mm), pad 0.65; JLC capabilities (fetched 2026-10-28): multilayer PTH annulus min 0.15, recommended 0.20; hole tol +0.13/-0.08 -> 0.32 worst finished vs 0.32 max contact diagonal.
findings.fix: Use 0.70 pads on 0.40 drills. Edge 1.74 mm in front of the rear slot centres (rear slots at x 36.327 for core's edge 34.587). Order remark: selective/hand solder, inspect A4-A5/B4-B5/B8-B9 for bridges. Bring-up: ohm CC1/CC2 to VBUS before PD.
findings.margin: Annulus 0.15 vs 0.15 min (0 %); pad gap 0.15; worst-case hole/pin clearance 0 mm

findings.finding: New HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 (C165948) is rated 20 V / 5 A, -30..+80 C. Lite runs up to a 20 V PD contract (SMBJ20A), so the rating margin is 0 % (PD allows 21 V). Shell slot pads in HRO's pattern are 0.9 mm (annulus 0.15 < JLC 2-layer 0.18 min). The edge must be 5.79 mm in front of the peg centres.
findings.evidence: HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 drawing rev A 2020-12-08 (LCSC C165948 datasheet); EasyEDA C165948 model; KiCad USB_C_Receptacle_HRO_TYPE-C-31-M-12.
findings.fix: Pull the EasyEDA/KiCad footprint (1.0-1.2 mm shell pads), put the pegs 5.79 mm from the top edge (pegs at y 66.113 for edge 60.323), use the 1.4 mm rear slot, re-run cpl_verify. Accept the 20 V rating or cap PD at 15 V if the power review allows.
findings.margin: Voltage rating 20 V vs 21 V max PD (-5 %); annulus 0.2 with 1.0 pads vs 0.18 min (11 %)

findings.finding: Both boards are ordered HASL but carry 0.4-0.5 mm pitch QFN/DFN (CH224Q 0.224 mm pads, ES7243E, ES8388 0.45, LAN8720A, ES9018K2M) and a 0.5 mm FFC. Uneven HASL on small pads risks floating parts and opens.
findings.evidence: Job files: Finish HASL. Footprint pad widths 0.224-0.23 mm. JLC capability page warns of HASL short risk on fine features and requires ENIG for 0.2-0.25 pads.
findings.fix: Order ENIG on both boards (a few tens of $ per 5-board order, unverified).
findings.margin: Pad 0.224 mm on 0.40 pitch with HASL

findings.finding: EP paste is 100 % (no paste ratio anywhere) except Lite U8, whose 4 windows sit right on its 16 open 0.3 mm vias. ES8388, CH224A, ES9018K2M and LAN8720A EPs have open vias under 100 % paste. Core ESP32 pad 2 has an open via in the pad.
findings.evidence: Board pad dump: 0 solder_paste_margin entries; U8 windows 7.84/14.1 mm2 = 55 % but each window holds 4 vias; via counts in EP: Lite U7 1, U1 3, U8 16; core U10 9, U9 1.
findings.fix: Window EP paste to 50-70 % between the vias (solder_paste_margin_ratio -0.2..-0.3 or explicit windows). Move U8's windows off the via rows. Move core U7 pad-2 via about 0.5 mm off the pad. Option: JLC filled/capped via-in-pad.

findings.finding: No fiducials and no tooling holes on either board. Core's USB shell overhangs the left edge by 0.975 mm, so a rail there would collide.
findings.evidence: 0 fiducial footprints; JLC capability page: 1 mm fiducials, 2 mm tooling holes, 5 mm rails for SMT.
findings.fix: Add 3 fiducials per board (1 mm Cu / 2 mm mask, >= 3.85 mm from the edge). Tell JLC no rail on the USB edge.

findings.finding: Merged PTH+NPTH drill file (MixedPlating). Core has 21 vias of 0.20/0.45, exactly at JLC's small-via price threshold (<0.45 costs more). Core C5/C311 silk lands on the pads (0.40 mm2 each).
findings.evidence: gerbonara read of both zips; drl header TF.FileFunction MixedPlating; via list from the PCB.
findings.fix: Export separate PTH/NPTH drill files; make the 0.2 mm vias 0.20/0.50; move the C5/C311 silk 0.15 mm off the pads.

findings.finding: Ultra U19 is ordered as PLR237/T8BK (C17223620) on a PLR237/T10BK footprint. The T8BK has two 1.70 mm locating posts (5.60 apart) with no holes, so the part sits about 1.7 mm high and tilted. Pin numbering is mirrored between T8 (1=Vout,3=Vcc) and T10 (1=VCC,3=VOUT) but physically the same, so the present nets are right; any renumbering must keep the physical Vcc pin on OPT_VCC.
findings.evidence: Everlight DPL-0000262/263 rev1 p5 (T8BK) vs DPL-0000261 rev1 p5 (T10BK); board dump of U19 (0.914 x3, 1.1 x2, no 1.7 holes); T10BK C17427482 stock 0.
findings.fix: Make a T8BK footprint: add 2x 1.70 holes at +-2.80, 2.61 beyond the NC row; re-check the port-to-edge offset (T8 side view 5.88 vs T10 6.14); keep the physical Vcc pin on OPT_VCC.
findings.margin: Post height 1.70 mm with 0 mm clearance

findings.finding: KF301-5.0 footprint drill 1.4 against KEFA's 1.2 (+0.1/0) for 1.0 pins.
findings.evidence: KEFA KF301-5.0 drawing rev A 2021-03-13; board pad dump.
findings.margin: 0.2 mm over the maker's maximum hole

findings.finding: EC11: LCSC part is EC11E1834403 on a footprint named EC11E1820402; the footprint centres the 7.5/7.0 rows, so the shaft is 0.25 mm off the origin. FFC J3 orientation and cable type are unverified (LCSC PDF corrupt). IRM-3638T lens direction is taken from the enclosure claim.
findings.evidence: Alps EC11 catalogue p279; EasyEDA C361165; LCSC C2856803 PDF unreadable.
findings.fix: Cut the knob hole at the true shaft position; confirm FFC cable type A/B against the panel; confirm the IR lens faces the front window on a sample.

tools_wanted.checks: For each THT part: pin cross-section and tolerance from the drawing against finished hole (drill +0.13/-0.08) and post/peg holes present

tools_wanted.checks: Back off and resume EasyEDA fetches inside one run instead of failing every later part
tools_wanted.why: Core verification needed many reruns over 30+ min

tools_wanted.why: hwde has no check for EP paste/via wicking
